description: Use when the user asks for drill core scanned by HyLogger (the national NVCL library, as CoreFlagging shows it): holes by name, operator or project (q), around a point (lon, lat, radius_km), in a bbox, and/or in a State. Returns each hole's key, name, State, operator, project, scanned depth range, instrument, whether it has logged geology, gold metres, lon/lat, distance, and a CoreFlagging link. get_core_scan_hole with the key gives one hole's details.

state.description: WA, SA, NT, QLD, NSW, VIC or TAS.

name: find_core_scans
title: Find scanned drill core
